title: Reserve mandatory canonical discovery time before optional notes paging
outcome: Optional older-note pages give way before their calls consume the time required for the full contract, selected records and their revalidation, and canonical binding reads; slow successful optional pages should not force an otherwise admissible request into a discovery-budget refusal.
acceptance: A request-path test with successful slow optional notes pages and funded mandatory discovery reads stops optional paging with time_budget while retaining enough time for the full contract, selected-record revalidation and canonical binding reads; an actually issued failed canonical page still refuses before evaluator admission.
